_comment: English body for prompt-case-bug-repro. Sections keyed by Chinese heading; sources aligned by index.

sections.任务与输入:
Output environment, steps, expected/actual and missing information; do not guess the root cause.
Inputs: Bug description, log excerpts, and environment information.
sections.提示词本体:
```text
Turn the bug into a minimal reproduction. Output environment, steps[], expected, actual and missing[]. steps must be executable and come from the description; put unprovided versions/config into missing, do not fill defaults. Do not give a root-cause conclusion.
```

Replace {field} placeholders with the current inputs before running.
sections.预期输出形态: environment, steps[], expected, actual, and missing[].
sections.检查点:
- Each step is supported by the description.
- Missing items are explicit.
- No root-cause assertion.
sections.失败分支:
- Steps not executable: fill missing items and rerun.
- Insufficient logs: keep only checkable excerpts.
sections.出处与边界: This site has not tested the effect of this prompt. See the sources for the mechanism; changing model, version or input can change the result.

sources: OpenAI Cookbook: GPT-4.1 Prompting Guide (official repository raw, fetched 200 on 2026-11-07)
